comparison.objective: Cut foam along a printed curve by steering the workpiece around a fixed hot ribbon.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous path following with reversed motion and changing workpiece orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Foam follows the printed cut curve; path tolerance, damage criteria, and release requirements are not stated.
comparison.reason: Tests continuous workpiece steering through a fixed cutter, unlike discrete coaxial impacts that fracture tangs while preserving inserts.
